lightArc: Bright early-afternoon sun, crisp dappled light, fresh greens with the first yellow leaves (p01–p05) → mid-afternoon, sunlight twinkling through yellow birch leaves (p06–p08) → late afternoon, warmer and more golden, long soft shadows (p09–p11, e1–e3) → early evening indoors, warm lamp light with a pink-gold sky outside, never dark (e4). The warm accents are the sunbeams, Abuelo's yellow cap and the squirrels' orange-red fur.

images.mood: curious, warm, an adventure about to begin
images.scene: Noelia crouches on the sandy path beside the mossy log, hands tucked behind her back, smiling at Pipa, who sits up on top of the log. Both look up together at the tall trees of Pinecone Wood rising above them. Far back along the path, Abuelo waves.
